title: Gerfaut — Complete
author: Charles de Bernard
description: "Gerfaut — Complete" by Charles de Bernard is a novel set in the early 19th century, recognized as the author's most significant work.
longDescription: The narrative revolves around complex themes of love and desire, particularly focusing on the relationship between the protagonist, a young man named Gerfaut, and a married woman, Madame de Bergenheim.

authorInfo.bio: Charles de Bernard (1804–1850) wrote Gerfaut — Complete. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
